list.title: Alerts and inconsistencies
list.subtitle: Open alerts, acknowledgements and DNS/DHCP mismatches

actions.adoptOn: On {{node}}, the node that holds the file

ack.title: Acknowledge the alert
ack.prompt: Optional comment, kept in the audit log

emptyHelp: The collector raises alerts on pools, zones, HA, DDNS, nodes and DNS/DHCP mismatches.

ignore.title: Ignore: admin's choice
ignore.body_one: This object stays as it is: the check no longer raises an alert for it until the exception is revoked. A health check alert is ignored on its own node only.
ignore.body_other: These {{count}} objects stay as they are: the check no longer raises an alert for them until the exceptions are revoked. A health check alert is ignored on its own node only.
ignore.commentHelp: Required, kept with the exception and in the audit log
ignore.commentRequired: Say why the object is left as it is

exceptions.title: Alert exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Objects left as they are by choice: the checks raise nothing for them
exceptions.author: By
exceptions.revokeConfirm: Revoke the exception for {{key}}? The check raises its alert again at its next pass.
exceptions.emptyHelp: Ignore an inconsistency or a health check alert from its alert, or a PTR from the orphan PTR page.
exceptions.newHelp: Keep an object as it is before its alert is raised: the check will raise nothing for it.
exceptions.keyHelp: As the alert names it, for example {{example}}

unavailable.title: Partial view
unavailable.body: Alerts of {{nodes}} are not shown: {{error}}. Lists and counts cover the nodes that answered.

notify.linkGone: This alert no longer exists: it was resolved and purged
